observations.stdout:
A portable Markdown knowledge base for agents with shell and file access (kb v0.7.0)

USAGE kb init|doctor|uninstall|recall|map|get-node|get|list-topics|read-raw|read-session|capture-session|mark-extracted|sessions|summarize|summaries

COMMANDS

             init    Initialize a KB vault                                                              
           doctor    Report KB vault + dependency health                                                
        uninstall    Remove KB (preserves vault)                                                        
           recall    Search curated wiki pages                                                          
              map    Project a compact structural map of the wiki for navigation                        
         get-node    Fetch exact page or section content by node ID                                     
              get    Fetch a curated wiki page                                                          
      list-topics    List curated topic headings from the vault index                                   
         read-raw    Read a bounded excerpt from raw/ with explicit approval                            
     read-session    Read a bounded excerpt from sessions/ with explicit approval                       
  capture-session    Capture a session manifest from JSON stdin: session_id and optional transcript_path
   mark-extracted    Mark a session manifest as extracted (sets extracted: true)                        
         sessions    List session manifest names (never content)                                        
        summarize    Generate or return a cached session summary                                        
        summaries    Manage cached session summaries                                                    

Use kb <command> --help for more information about a command.

KB vault initialized at <fixture>/vault

Created:
  + <fixture>/vault
  + wiki/
  + raw/
  + sessions/
  + sessions/summaries/
  + sessions/.trash/
  + KB.md
  + index.md
  + log.md
  + context.md
  + .kb/state.json
  + .kb/config.json

Next steps:
  1. Set KB_VAULT to "<fixture>/vault" in your agent's environment.
  2. Give your agent skills/kb/SKILL.md from this repository and read the vault's KB.md.
  3. Use kb map to discover knowledge, then kb get-node to retrieve evidence.
  Optional Claude Code integration: claude plugin marketplace add JustinBeaudry/kb; claude plugin install kb@kb

qmd is optional — install for hybrid BM25 + vector search:

  npm install -g @tobilu/qmd
  qmd collection add <vault-path> --name kb --mask "**/*.md"
  qmd embed

Optionally add the MCP server to your agent's configuration if it supports MCP:

  { "mcpServers": { "qmd": { "command": "qmd", "args": ["mcp"] } } }

See https://github.com/qntx-labs/qmd for details.
